answer.label: system-prompted
answer.justification: The activation profile matches system-prompted. Relative L2 is 0.139 at layer 1 and rises steeply with onset at layer 8, then plateaus at 0.499 at layer 16 and 0.527 at layer 32. The layer-2 spike is 31.2, close to the system-prompted range of 31.7-64.0 and far above the ~6 maximum for quantized and fine-tuned. Final cosine is 0.835, the mid-layer size ratio is 0.973 (below 1), direction consistency is 0.543, and the final-layer jump is +0.036, all consistent with system-prompted. Fine-tuned is ruled out because its size ratio grows above 1 and its layer-2 spike is small. Quantized is ruled out because its curve is flat and its layer-1 to layer-32 values are much lower. Some values sit slightly outside the documented ranges, but this is a single draw and they are close.
